value.rationale: A sharp positive-weight loss of L2 contractivity at a unique radius is a natural stability boundary for weighted harmonic Dirichlet extension. Strict discrete hazard ordering provides a complete mode classification; Gamma-tail asymptotics identify an exact non-unit boundary amplification and the frequency scale. These are structural, not a routine restatement of the known Fourier expansion.
